points.title: 航海准备
points.description: 麦哲伦在葡萄牙开始了他的航海生涯，为他的环球航行做准备。他在葡萄牙海军服役，并参与了多次航海探险。1497年，他加入了葡萄牙的远征队，试图找到通往印度的西航路线。
points.descriptionEn: Ferdinand Magellan began his maritime career in Portugal, preparing for his circumnavigation. He served in the Portuguese navy and participated in several expeditions. In 1497, he joined a Portuguese expedition to find a westward route to India.

points.title: 环球航行
points.description: 麦哲伦在西班牙获得了西班牙王室的资助，开始了他的环球航行。他的船队穿越了大西洋，绕过南美洲南端的海峡，进入太平洋。尽管他在菲律宾被杀，但他的船队最终完成了环球航行，证明了地球是圆的。
points.descriptionEn: Ferdinand Magellan received funding from the Spanish crown to embark on his circumnavigation. His fleet crossed the Atlantic, rounded the southern tip of South America, and entered the Pacific. Although he was killed in the Philippines, his fleet eventually completed the circumnavigation, proving that the Earth is round.

points.title: 穿越海峡
points.description: 麦哲伦的船队穿越了南美洲南端的海峡，这是他们环球航行中最危险的部分之一。他们成功穿越后，进入了太平洋，开始了长达数月的航行。
points.descriptionEn: Ferdinand Magellan's fleet crossed the strait at the southern tip of South America, one of the most dangerous parts of their circumnavigation. After successfully crossing, they entered the Pacific, beginning a journey that lasted several months.

points.title: 菲律宾战役
points.description: 麦哲伦在菲律宾与当地土著人发生冲突，并在一次战役中丧生。尽管他的死亡标志着他的航海生涯的结束，但他的船队继续前进，最终完成了环球航行。
points.descriptionEn: Ferdinand Magellan was killed in the Philippines during a conflict with local tribesmen. Although his death marked the end of his maritime career, his fleet continued on, ultimately completing the circumnavigation.

points.title: 环球航行的完成
points.description: 尽管麦哲伦本人已经去世，但他的船队最终返回西班牙，完成了环球航行。这一成就证明了地球是圆的，并开辟了新的贸易路线。
points.descriptionEn: Although Ferdinand Magellan himself had died, his fleet eventually returned to Spain, completing the circumnavigation. This achievement proved that the Earth is round and opened up new trade routes.

appraisal.zh: 麦哲伦在学界被视为环球航行的先驱，其远航对地理学与航海学影响深远，大众文化中也常以勇敢探险家的形象出现。但另一种看法认为，他的航行同样给当地土著带来巨大破坏，决策时有冒进致船员伤亡，其殖民主义行为与对土著文化的摧残构成不容回避的历史局限。
appraisal.en: Magellan is regarded in scholarship as a pioneer of circumnavigation, whose voyage profoundly shaped geography and navigation, and popular culture often portrays him as a brave explorer. Another view holds that his voyages also brought great destruction to indigenous peoples, that his sometimes reckless decisions cost crew members their lives, and that his colonialist actions and damage to indigenous cultures remain an inescapable historical limitation.

supporter.zh: 麦哲伦被视为一位伟大的探险家和航海家，他的主要贡献是证明了地球是圆的，并开辟了新的贸易路线。他的精神遗产在于对未知世界的探索和勇气。
supporter.en: Ferdinand Magellan is regarded as a great explorer and navigator, with his main contribution being the proof that the Earth is round and the opening of new trade routes. His legacy lies in the exploration and courage towards the unknown world.

critic.zh: 麦哲伦的航海活动对当地土著人造成了巨大的破坏，他的决策有时过于冒险，导致船员的伤亡。他的历史局限在于他的殖民主义行为和对土著文化的破坏。
critic.en: Ferdinand Magellan's maritime activities caused great destruction to the indigenous peoples, and his decisions were sometimes too risky, leading to the deaths of crew members. His historical limitations lie in his colonialist actions and the destruction of indigenous cultures.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，麦哲伦被视为环球航行的先驱，他的成就对地理学和航海学产生了深远的影响。在大众文化中，他通常被描绘为勇敢的探险家，但他的殖民主义行为也受到批评。
objective.en: In the historical community, Ferdinand Magellan is seen as a pioneer of the circumnavigation, with his achievements having a profound impact on geography and navigation. In popular culture, he is often portrayed as a brave explorer, but his colonialist actions are also criticized.

self.zh: “我愿意为国王和葡萄牙的荣耀而牺牲。”
self.en: "I am willing to sacrifice myself for the glory of the king and Portugal."
